about: Incorporated on November 15, 2019, Jio Platforms Limited is a technology company focused on digital connectivity, digital services and technology-led solutions in India. The Company has developed proprietary digital technology and pan-India connectivity infrastructure to support the delivery of digital services to consumers and businesses. Its subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited, served 533.3 million customers as of June 30, 2026.The Company operates through an integrated technology platform encompassing digital connectivity, consumer applications, enterprise solutions, cloud services, Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI). Its consumer offerings include mobile and fixed broadband, digital entertainment, cloud storage, virtual PC services and smart home solutions. For businesses, it provides enterprise connectivity, cloud and security solutions, managed services, IoT applications and AI-based solutions. The Company’s proprietary technology capabilities span network infrastructure, device engineering, software, operating systems and digital applications.

The Company’s infrastructure includes pan-India 4G and 5G connectivity, fibre connectivity across more than 1,200 facilities and over 100 edge nodes within its networks as of June 30, 2026. Its wireless broadband network covered more than 99% of India’s population. The Company and its subsidiaries had filed 7,220 patent applications, of which 1,043 had been granted, as of June 30, 2026. Its technology initiatives include an indigenous 5G technology stack, proprietary AI platform JioBrain and fixed wireless access technology. The Company also leverages a nationwide distribution network and partnerships to expand access to digital services.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 27,932 full-time employees and engaged 63,795 personnel on a contract basis. Its workforce includes teams across digital products and technology development, business operations, sales and distribution, customer service, network operations, and corporate functions.

Competitive Strengths: Leadership in digital connectivity and services across India.
Diversified portfolio of consumer and enterprise digital services.
Large and highly engaged customer base with nationwide reach.
Nationwide digital distribution network and strategic group synergies.
Proven ability to scale operations and deploy new technologies rapidly.
Extensive pan-India network infrastructure with 4G and 5G capabilities.
Proprietary technology platform with in-house engineering and full-stack capabilities.
Strong innovation capabilities supported by patents, AI and technology development.

about: Incorporated in1987, Paras Healthcare Limited is a leading clinical specialty-led hospital platform providing tertiary and quaternary healthcare services across North India, Bihar, and Jharkhand under the "Paras Health" brand. The company operates eight hospitals with an aggregate bed capacity of 2,211 beds across Gurugram, Panchkula, Patna, Darbhanga, Kanpur, Udaipur, Ranchi, and Srinagar as of June 30, 2026.
It specializes in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastro sciences, orthopedics & sports injury, and renal sciences (CONGOR specialties), which contributed 75.30% of revenue in Fiscal 2026.

Paras Healthcare has over 20 years of operating history and follows a balanced growth strategy through mature, emerging, and new hospitals. The company plans to expand its network with a 300-bed hospital in Gurugram and a 500-bed hospital in Ludhiana, increasing total capacity to 3,011 beds by March 2028.
As of March 31, 2026, it had 4,670 employees, including 1,084 doctors and 1,937 nurses.

about: Incorporated in June 2014, Core4 Engineers Limited is an Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning (“EPCC”) company providing integrated infrastructure solutions across railway infrastructure, power transmission and distribution, and water and wastewater treatment. The Company offers end-to-end project execution capabilities covering design, engineering, procurement, construction, installation, testing, commissioning and operations and maintenance.The Company operates through five business segments: railway electrification and infrastructure, Extra High Tension (“EHT”) transmission and distribution systems, water and wastewater treatment EPCC, automation and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (“SCADA”) systems, and supply of High-Tension (“HT”) and Low-Tension (“LT”) distribution panels and related services.

Its railway infrastructure activities include overhead electrification, traction substations, station redevelopment, civil works and allied signalling and telecommunication interfaces. In power transmission and distribution, it undertakes turnkey projects involving substations, transmission lines and distribution networks up to 220 kV. Its water and wastewater division provides solutions for water treatment plants, sewage treatment plants and effluent treatment plants, supported by automation and process control systems.

The Company also designs and implements PLC-based automation and SCADA systems for railway, power and water infrastructure projects. Its in-house manufacturing facility produces HT/LT distribution and control panels, including VCB, PCC, MCC, APFC and PLC-based automation panels, as well as compact substations. This manufacturing capability complements its EPCC operations by supporting customization, cost efficiency, quality control and timely project execution. The Company also undertakes subcontracting assignments, providing on-ground execution support for engineering and infrastructure projects.

The Company serves government organizations, public sector undertakings, utilities, infrastructure contractors and private enterprises across India. Its business model combines multidisciplinary project execution, in-house design and engineering capabilities, panel manufacturing and vendor partnerships to deliver integrated infrastructure solutions.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 462 personnel, comprising 62 employees on its payroll and 400 floating labourers engaged primarily for project execution.

Diversified Business Portfolio.
Experienced Project Workforce.

about: Incorporated on May 14, 2008, EAAA India Alternatives Limited is an alternative investment management platform focused on India’s real assets and private credit markets. It manages investment funds and provides alternative investment solutions to domestic and global institutional investors, high-net-worth individuals (“HNIs”), ultra-high-net-worth individuals (“UHNIs”) and family offices.The Company operates primarily through two business verticals: Real Assets and Private Credit, along with portfolio management services and other investment solutions. Its Real Assets vertical invests in infrastructure, commercial real estate, perpetual capital and energy transition opportunities through equity, quasi-equity and debt instruments. Its Private Credit vertical provides financing solutions across performing credit, special situations, real estate credit and investment-grade credit. The Company also offers co-investment opportunities through portfolio management services.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company managed assets under management (“AUM”) of ₹953,448.78 million and fee-paying assets under management (“FPAUM”) of ₹486,231.76 million. Its portfolio comprised 10 active Real Assets funds, including two Infrastructure Investment Trusts (“InvITs”), and 16 active Private Credit funds. The Company is supported by its wholly owned subsidiary, Sekura India Management Limited, which provides asset operating and management capabilities, including operations, maintenance, monitoring and efficiency improvement.
The Company has a diversified client base and a technology-enabled investment platform supported by dedicated investment, asset management, coverage and enterprise teams.
As of June 30, 2026, it had 277 employees across investment, asset operating and management, coverage, enterprise, legal and compliance, and other functions.

about: Incorporated in March 2005, SFC Environmental Technologies Limited is an environmental technology company engaged in providing technology, design, engineering, manufacturing, supply, installation and commissioning solutions for wastewater treatment (“WWT”), wastewater recycling and reuse (“WRR”), and solid waste treatment (“SWT”). The Company’s wastewater treatment business is primarily based on its proprietary C-Tech technology, an advanced sequencing batch reactor (“SBR”) process used in sewage treatment plants and industrial effluent treatment. Its solutions include technology packages, equipment, automation systems, installation, commissioning and related services. As of July 31, 2026, the Company had commissioned 728 wastewater treatment installations and its technologies facilitated the treatment of 17,511.11 million litres of wastewater per day. It has also expanded into wastewater recycling and reuse through ultrafiltration (“UF”), closed circuit reverse osmosis (“CCRO”) and membrane bioreactor (“MBR”) technologies, supported by an exclusive supply arrangement with DuPont for selected products in India.

The Company’s solid waste treatment business is based on its proprietary Organic Extraction (“OREX”) technology, designed to separate biodegradable organic matter from mixed municipal waste to support biogas generation and resource recovery. It provides end-to-end solutions covering design, engineering, construction, equipment supply, commissioning and operations and maintenance. The Company operates two integrated solid waste treatment facilities in Goa with an aggregate treatment capacity of up to 425 tonnes per day. Through its subsidiary, it has also secured orders for compressed biogas plants in Assam and Odisha, with cumulative order value of ₹5,017 million, and has expanded into projects involving agricultural waste and biomass.

The Company operates across 23 states and five Union Territories in India, with a business model involving technology supply, engineering solutions, project execution and operations and maintenance. Its customer relationships include engineering, procurement and construction companies, municipal bodies and government-owned entities. The Company’s growth strategy includes expanding its wastewater recycling and reuse capabilities and pursuing opportunities in solid waste treatment, compressed biogas and waste-to-energy projects.

As of August 31, 2026, the Company had 264 employees, including 149 engineers, supported by teams across design and engineering, electrical and instrumentation, erection and commissioning, manufacturing, proposals, sales, finance and other functions.

Competitive Strengths: Technology-Driven Market Leadership: Strong position in wastewater treatment, supported by proprietary C-Tech technology and over 80% market share in SBR technology in India.
Integrated Technology and Engineering Capabilities: Comprehensive solutions across design, engineering, equipment supply, installation, commissioning and operations and maintenance.
Established Presence in Wastewater Recycling and Reuse: Expansion into UF, CCRO and MBR technologies, supported by an exclusive supply arrangement with DuPont for selected products in India.
Proprietary Solid Waste Treatment Technology: OREX technology enables organic waste separation, biogas generation and recovery of recyclable resources.

Strong Order Book and Repeat Business: High repeat-customer revenue, contributing 91.98% of revenue in Fiscal 2026, alongside significant orders in wastewater recycling and compressed biogas projects.
Diversified Growth Opportunities: Presence across wastewater treatment, wastewater recycling and reuse, solid waste treatment, compressed biogas and waste-to-energy projects.

about: Incorporated in September 2022, Wiscon Industries Limited is a Delhi-based company engaged in the trading and supply of consumer electronic products across India.
The company offers a broad range of products, including LED TVs, air coolers, washing machines, and air conditioners under its flagship "Wiscon" brand.
It also sells electric scooters sourced from third-party brands.

Wiscon serves both business customers (B2B) and individual consumers (B2C). Its products are distributed through an offline dealer and distributor network as well as its own online platform, allowing the company to reach customers across the country. Sales operations are managed by a dedicated team working from the company's registered office.

The company has reported strong revenue growth since its incorporation. Revenue from operations increased from ₹ 321.45 lakh in FY 2023-24 to ₹1,449.27 lakh in FY 2024-25, and further to ₹7,339.16 lakh in FY 2025-26, reflecting significant business expansion over the three-year period.
As of September 30, 2026, Wiscon Industries had 76 permanent employees supporting its operations.

about: Incorporated in August 2009, Carver Roboweld Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of welding consumables, including Metal Cored Wires, Welding Rods and Gauging Electrodes, along with the supply of welding spare parts and accessories. The Company has also expanded its offerings to provide value-added engineering solutions to the forging industry, including forging die regeneration and welding robot rental services.

The Company operates its primary manufacturing facility in Bamanbore, Rajkot, Gujarat, with additional service units in Pune, Hosur and Ludhiana, enabling it to serve customers across key industrial markets in India. As of July 11, 2026, the Company had an aggregate installed production capacity of 650 tonnes per annum for Metal Cored Wires and Welding Rods, reflecting a capacity CAGR of approximately 30% between Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2026.

Through its subsidiary, Carver Engineering Private Limited, acquired in September 2025, the Company also provides re-conditioning and refurbishment services for plant and machinery across industries such as forging, casting, cement, steel, sugar, power, petroleum, automotive and fabrication. Its engineering services include heavy-duty machining, structural fabrication, repair and refurbishment of hammers and components, and turnkey engineering projects.

The Company has a presence across several Indian states and caters to industrial customers through its welding consumables and engineering solutions. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified and is a Sustaining Corporate Member of the American Welding Society (AWS), reflecting its focus on quality management and adherence to international welding standards.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 68 permanent employees and 75 contract workers.

about: Incorporated in December 2019, Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited is a steel processing centre engaged in converting steel coils into value-added processed steel products for Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) and Original Design Manufacturers (“ODMs”). The Company specialises in precision slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing and embossing of steel coils to manufacture slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks. Its products serve multiple end-use industries, including home and commercial appliances, automotive and auto components, electrical equipment, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, ventilation systems and general engineering. In addition to processing steel coils, the Company provides logistics and inventory management services and supports customers through just-in-time delivery solutions.

The Company operates four strategically located manufacturing facilities at Wada and Bhiwandi in Maharashtra, Ghiloth in Rajasthan, and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh. Spread across an aggregate area of 42,209 square metres, these facilities are equipped with slitting, cut-to-length, shearing and embossing lines. The Company has an authorised service partnership with JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (“JSWSCPL”) and/or its holding company since 2021, supporting regular access to steel coils. As of June 30, 2026, its aggregate installed processing capacity was 1,23,153 metric tonnes per annum, calculated on a quarterly basis for Fiscal 2027.

The Company serves a diversified customer base across consumer durables, home appliances, refrigeration, automotive, electrical equipment, electronics, industrial engineering and other manufacturing sectors. Its customers include OEMs and ODMs such as Haier Appliances India Private Limited, IFB Refrigeration Limited, Dixon Electro Manufacturing Private Limited, Amber Enterprises India Limited and Western Refrigeration Private Limited.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 164 personnel, comprising 160 permanent employees and 4 employees on retainership.
